title: French Croissant Suet Puff Pastry
description: A flaky and buttery French pastry puff made with suet and croissant dough. Perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: Roll out croissant dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Brush melted suet and buttery over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Brush beaten egg over the edges of the dough to seal.
Fold the dough in half lengthwise, and press edges to seal.
Cut into desired shapes using a pastry cutter or knife.
Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.
